Your BS-2 hasn't shipped yet, and its ship date has passed. I'm sorry, we should have written to you about that and didn't. It ships from BitFortun directly and I don't have a confirmed new date, so I won't guess one.

Two things: I've asked the team for the current date, and you're also owed the $50 BitFortun terahash refund, since the listing overstated the hashrate on BS-2 orders placed before September 25. That goes back to the card you paid with.

Stay in the chat, one of them will jump in.
What’s the correct hashrate of the unit

The corrected figure is 8.5 TH/s. That's what the BS-2 listing and the spec sheet read now, at about 150 W at the wall, two BM1373 chips, water cooled.

The older listing quoted a higher number the unit doesn't hit in practice, which is why the $50 goes back to you.
